text:
maria (runtime): Heads-up: planning a canary for the new matmul-v2 kernel + int4 packer tonight 02:00-06:00 UTC. Seeking quick eyes on preflight and rollback plan.

sam (sre): Thanks — what's the observable gating? p99 latency / error rate thresholds? :eyes: 

maria (runtime): Short version: gate if p99 token latency increases >10% or 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m in canary. Also watch for tail memory OOMs on small instances (we changed packing alignment).

alice (ml): Noted. Matmul-v2 changes packing order to reduce memory reads; should lower avg latency but could spike for odd-length sequences. Test harness shows small p99 regressions at batch sizes 1-2.

dmitri (infra): Canary plan: 1% traffic in us-west-2 for 30m, then 5% for 30m, then 20% for 30m if healthy. I can run the deploybot rollout and pause between ramps.

maria (runtime): Exact deploybot command:
```
/deploy canary kernel=matmul-v2 image=runtime:2026-03-20 region=us-west-2 pct=1 wait=30m
```
Please keep a pinned log.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received: kernel=matmul-v2, region=us-west-2, initial pct=1. Starting canary. (CI: infra-ci) :rocket:

infra-ci: Preflight checks passed: unit tests ok, perf smoke ok, packaging hash a1b2c3.

sam (sre): I'll be onwatch during the window. @sre-oncall please be available for rollback if we see memory OOMs.

sre-oncall: Oncall here — available from 01:45 UTC. I want a quick artifact pin if we need to rollback.

maria (runtime): Rollback plan (concise):
- Immediate: Pause rollout and pin traffic back to matmul-v1.17 via /deploy rollback kernel=matmul-v1.17
- If pause fails: Force traffic shift to dedicated fallback model-group (fallback-route) for 100% for 10m.
- Postmortem: Collect core dumps, perf profiles, and KV-cache hit metrics.

alice (ml): Add this to criteria: quality regression >2 ROUGE points on the smoke eval prompts over 10m window. We ran a small eval harness just now; attaching snippet below.
```
Eval: 50 prompts, matmul-v1.17: avg_score=0.87, matmul-v2: avg_score=0.85
```

maria (runtime): Good call. We'll require no quality regression >2 points and stability gates to pass.

dmitri (infra): Also: any change to alignment/padding needs kernel ABI note for on-prem customers. Prepare release note: "matmul-v2 changes int4 packing alignment — may require node driver 3.2+"

maria (runtime): I'll draft release notes and a quick migration snippet.

maria (runtime): Release notes snippet (draft):
"matmul-v2 (2026-03-20): rewrites the GPU matmul path to a vectorized packer that reduces memory reads for aligned tensors. Improves throughput for long sequences. Known issue: odd-length token sequences on small GPUs may see transient p99 regressions; see rollback instructions. Requires runtime-driver >=3.2 for on-prem deployments"

sam (sre): Can we add an automated metric to detect packer misalignment? Something like a counter when sequence_length % 8 != 0 and packing fallback is triggered.

alice (ml): We have probe traces in the harness that emit `pack_fallback` events. I can add a dashboard tile and an alert: >0.1% pack_fallback over 5m triggers paging.

maria (runtime): Please add that alert and set it to page the oncall.

infra-ci: Canary canary rollout at 1% is complete. Telemetry: p99 +2.3%, 5xx = 0.06%, pack_fallback = 0.02%. No OOMs.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 5% started.

maria (runtime): Monitor the p99 trend closely during the 5% stage. If p99 > 10% or pack_fallback >0.1% for 5 minutes, pause and roll back.

dmitri (infra): 5% stage stable at +3% p99, 5xx 0.08%, pack_fallback 0.03%. Proceeding to 20%.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 20% started.

infra-ci: 20% metrics after 15m: p99 +9.5%, 5xx 0.09%, pack_fallback 0.04%. Quality eval delta -0.8 points.

sam (sre): Good. All gates green so far. I'll keep the window open another 30m and then schedule full rollout if stable.

maria (runtime): Thanks team. Action items:
- alice: add pack_fallback dashboard & alert (done?)
- dmitri: pin rollback scripts and add extra log verbosity for canary
- sam: stay onwatch and ready to trigger rollback
- maria: publish release note + on-prem ABI note

alice (ml): dashboard tile added, alert wired to oncall — threshold 0.1% over 5m.

dmitri (infra): rollback script pinned at /ops/rollbacks/matmul-v1.17.sh and verified. Increased log verbosity flag `--pack-debug` available.

maria (runtime): Publishing release note now and closing this thread. Will start full rollout in 6 hours if no regressions. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Canary completed. No automated rollbacks. Logs archived to s3://redwood-deploy-logs/matmul-v2/1799991234/

sre-oncall: Thanks everyone — available if anything pops.

maria (runtime): Closing thread.
